description: The file 'wsclient.h' defines the interface for a WebSocket client in a software project. It includes copyright notices, include directives, a configuration structure, and function declarations related to WebSocket client operations such as initialization, starting, stopping, and messaging.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the WebSocket client subsystem.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_Start
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket client, establishing necessary connections.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_StartClient
methods.description: Begins a WebSocket client session with specified parameters.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_StopClient
methods.description: Stops a specific WebSocket client session.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_AllowConnect
methods.description: Permits the WebSocket client to proceed with connection attempts.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_ActivateScheduledActions
methods.description: Activates scheduled actions related to WebSocket client operations.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_QueueBinaryMessage
methods.description: Queues a binary message for transmission over WebSocket.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_GetRetryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of retries for a specific client instance.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_Main
methods.description: Main thread routine for the WebSocket client.

methods.name: WSCLIENT_IsEndpointConnected
methods.description: Checks if a given WebSocket endpoint is currently connected.
